doubtful.text_en: The sad truth is that most evil is done by people who never make up their minds to be either good or evil.
doubtful.text_zh: 可悲的真相是，大多数恶都是由那些从来没有下决心要做好人还是坏人的人做出来的。
doubtful.text_zh_note: 疑似出自《责任与判断》文集，需核对原著。

doubtful.text_en: There are no dangerous thoughts; thinking itself is dangerous.
doubtful.text_zh: 没有危险的思想；思考本身就是危险的。

verified.context: 1955 年 8 月 6 日致雅斯贝尔斯的信，时年 49 岁；《人的境况》写作期间。
verified.source: Hannah Arendt to Karl Jaspers, 6 August 1955, quoted in Elisabeth Young-Bruehl, Hannah Arendt: For Love of the World
verified.text_en: I've begun so late, really only in recent years, to truly love the world... Out of gratitude, I want to call my book on political theories "Amor Mundi".
verified.text_zh: 我开始得这么晚，真的只是在最近几年，才开始真正爱这个世界……出于感激，我想把我的政治理论之书叫作《爱世界》。

verified.context: 1964 年 Günter Gaus 电视访谈；她拒绝“哲学家”标签。
verified.text_en: I am sorry, but I have to object. I don't belong to the circle of philosophers. My profession, if you can call it that, is that of political theory.
verified.text_zh: 很抱歉，我不得不反对，我不属于哲学家这个圈子。我的职业，如果能这么叫的话，是政治理论。

verified.context: 《人的境况》中论爱的一段：爱摧毁两人之间的中介。
verified.text_en: Love, by reason of its passion, destroys the in-between which relates us to and separates us from others... Love, by its very nature, is unworldly, and it is for this reason rather than its rarity that it is not only apolitical but antipolitical.
verified.text_zh: 爱，由于它的激情，摧毁了联结我们又分隔我们的中介……爱，就其本性而言，是无世界的，正因为如此，而非因为它的稀有，它不仅是非政治的，而且是反政治的。

verified.context: 《人的境况》末尾附近；思考与行动的关系。出处页码待核实。
verified.source: Hannah Arendt, The Human Condition (1958) — 页码待核实
verified.text_en: To think and to be fully alive are the same.
verified.text_zh: 思考与充分地活着，是一回事。
